tei:div.tei:p: 79) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur pa bdud las rnam rgyal gyi drag sgrub zab mo bzhugs: 80)( Dakini secret letter here) na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:

o rgyan he ru ka la 'dud: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skyes bu rnams: yang gsang mchog gi lam 'jug tshe: bar chad g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir: lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu yi: drag sgrub zab mo 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i thabs: dug shog dag la khrag sna dang: dug snag bsres ma dgra bgegs gzugs: nyam thag gcer bu gos med pa: yan lag lcags su blugs pa dang: mig gnyis mthur du blta bar bri: kha ngu skra gzengs ba spu nyil: mdog sngo ham dang mtshan ma nyams: sha 'chor nyam thag gzugs bris la: sgo bzhir long dang 'on 'tshubs 81)lkugs: de bzhin dpral bar nan dang ni: brla dpung rnams la chag zhwa bri: gsang bar phaṭa dag snying ga ru: nṛ tri dza dza zhes dang ni: rbad sngags bsad sngags dag gis bskor: phyi la dza khram dmar nag ni: nyer gcig bdag gis bskor bar bya: rang gi dri ma slar bkrus nas: ro ltebs bya zhig hom du bcug: 'gugs bsgral gdab rdzas la sogs bsags: de nas las la 'jug pa ni: rnal 'byor de nyid 'di shes gnad: 'khor 'das rang snang shes pa dang: lha yi ting 'dzin gsal ba dang: tshe khrus gnad la mkhas pa yis: rdzong 'phrang srog gi chings cig yin: rang nyid yi dam skur gsal nas: snang srid lha yis phyag rgyar bsgom: phrin las gang brtsams dmigs pa ni: 82) nang la mi ldog gnad gcig yin: phur pa sras su byin brlabs nas: khams gsum sku gsum klong nyid du: skad cig grol zhus dbang thob pa: mi rdugs pa yi gnad gcig go: snod bcud 'jig rten ma lus pa: dgra bgegs bla tshe'i gshed du phabs: gang la dmigs pas brlag nus pa: de ni gzhan la mi 'byams gnad: rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros 'khor 'das yongs khyab cing: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i yon tan dang: mthu dang nus pa thams cad kun: tshur bsdus bdag la thim pa yis: 'khor 'das spyi dpal chen por bsgom: phurapa sras mchog gsal ba las:

'od 'phros srid zhi'i dwangs bcud dang: rgyal ba rnams kyi mthu nus rtsal: khab len rdo yis lcags bsdus ltar: phur bu nyid la thim par dmigs: ling ga dgra bgegs dngos gsal ba'i: snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i: 'od nag 'jig rten khyab pa yis: srid par gnas pa'i dgra bgegs kyi: bla tshe srog gsum dbyer med bstims: de ltar gnad dang ldan pa ni: gso ba gsum gyi dmigs pa'o: sa ma ya: de gas e khang bskyed pa dang: dmigs bya gsal ba ni: bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas e yig nag po 'od 'bar ba gcig spros pa las mdun du las kyi gshin rje'i btson khang nag po 83)rgya che la gting zab pa: dpangs mtho zhing gru gsum bang rim gsum dang ldan pa'i nang na gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs pa: 'og na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho rba rlabs rab tu 'khrugs pa: bar na phrag dog gi rlung nag 'tshubs shing: nga rgyal gyi brag ri tshag ldir du bsnyil ba: phyi la zhe sdang gi me dpung dmar nag drag tu 'bar ba'i mtha' skor du drag po'i rtsang gi drwa mig ris su bkram pa'i nang du nṛ tri gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi bla tshe srog gsum mthu dang nus pa thams cad stong gsum srid pa'i khams gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med par 'dus nas dmigs rten srog yig dang gnyis su med par thim par bsam: de yongs su gyur pa las dgra bgegs de nyid mdog sngo la ham pa: kha ngu ba: mig shi mig: lag pa mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can: rkang lag rnams lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa: lus kyi bu ga thams cad nas khrag 'dzag pa: byang sems dkar dmar thur du 'bab pa: mgon med skyabs dang bral zhing gcer bu nyam thag pa: rgyu ba'i dbugs dang bral la khad 84)pa 'dar phri li li byed pa zhig tu gyur: kho'i snying ga'i sa bon las 'od nag po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas stong gsum srid pa'i khams kyi dgra bgegs gnod byed sri ngan thams cad kyi bla tshe srog gi rten rnams skad cig rang dbang med par chu thig hub kyis tungs pa ltar bsdus nas ling ga dang gnyis su med par thim par gyur:

pho nya bran pa ni: rang nyid yi dam gyi thugs ka nas las byed sprul pa'i pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros pas gnod byed dgra bgegs sri ngan rnams kyi bla tshe srog gsum thams cad nam mkha' nas shog skya rlung gis gtor ba dang: bar snang nas ser ba 'thor rlung gis ded pa bzhin dang: sa gzhi'i khams nas ra lug 'phar spyang gis ded pa ltar rang dbang med par bkug nas: lcags kyus snying nas bzung: zhags pas rke nas bcings: lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams: dril bus myos su chug la 'phar ldang 'gul bskyod med par ling ga dang gnyis med du thim par gyur: de nas 'gugs pa ni: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam rnams kyi 85)bka' bden pa dang: sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi= yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi= don dam chos nyid ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i bka'= chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka'= bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa'i lag dmar: dam pa'i chos khrims bshig pa'i bdud sde: dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo bcom pa'i gshed ma: ting 'dzin sgom pa'i sems dkrugs shing bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba: chos sgrub yongs la 'tshe bar byed pa'i dam sri ya ma spun dgu dang: khyad par du bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la snga dgra lag gis byas pa: phyi dgra yid la bsam pa: da dgra thad kar langs pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar chad byed pa'i bdud bgegs dam sri la sogs pa gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad kyi tshe 86)bla srog gsum mthu nus rtsal shugs dang bcas pa thams cad stong gsum srid pa'i khams gang na gnas kyang skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig:

nri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ de ltar dgu re'i mtshams su spu gri'i sngags mthar: gnod byed dgra bgegs sri ngan rnams kyi bla tshe srog gsum khug dzaḥ nṛ tri yaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes pas gnod byed gang yin pa: dmigs pas gcun la ling ga ru: yang yang bstim pa gnad gces so: de nas bcing pa'i las ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: ma g.yel dam tshig thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dam nyams dgra bgegs sri ngan thams cad kyi: sgo gsum mthu stobs nus rtsal ma lus pa: khrol med las kyi phyag rgyas dam du chings: byad du chug la nam yang ldang med mdzod: rtsa sngags: ru tra du sri a mu ka mā ra ya chings chings bhan+dha bhan+dha swā hāḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: zhes brjod/ bdag mdun gyi sku las 'od zer sngo la dmar ba'i 'od dang ldan pa spros nas dgra bgegs sri ngan rnams kyi sgo gsum bla srog dang bcas pa g.yo 'gul 'phar ldang med par dam du bcings shing dkris bas nus mthu rtsal shugs thams cad nyams nas rdo thang la 87) 'phang ba ltar gyur par bsam: de nas lha dbye ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: ma g.yel dam tshig thugs dam gnad nas skul: nyams pa bdun ldan dgra bgegs 'di rnams kyi: skyob par byed pa'i lha srung kun dang phyes: mnyam por 'ong ba'i gshed bdud dang sprod cig: lo zla zhag tu ma 'gyangs mthu rtsal phyungs: dgra bgegs mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha dang phyes: 'gugs bsgral drag po'i las kyi dus la babs: rtsa sngags: ma ma traka rak+ṣa mā ra ya phyes phyes: dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams kyi mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha srung thams cad phyes shig khrol cig mā ra ya rbad dza: zhes brjod/ rang las sprul pa'i las byed kyi phra men ma rnams kyis brub khung khar 'dzing 'thab byed cing lus kyi ba spu thams cad nas dgra bgegs lha srung dbye bar byed pa'i dri ngan 'thul bas dgra bgegs rnams shul du bor nas mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha srung thams cad dbye zhing khong rnams skyabs bral mgon med du gyur par bsam:

de nas smyo ru gzhug pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ ma g.yel dam tshig thugs dam gnad nas skul: phrin las sprul pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'khrigs: dgra bgegs 88)sri ngan 'gugs bsgral dus la babs: lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la zhags pas chings: lcags sgrog gis sdom dril bus myos su chugs: dgra bgegs myos shing brgyal nas dran pa rmugs: bla srog rnam shes dbyer med gzugs la stims: rtsa sngags: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya a mu ka thib thib myos myos mā ra ya rbad dzaḥ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis khams gsum gyi 'khrul pa bag chags thams cad las rlung nag po'i rnam par byung ste dgra bgegs rnams kyi srin lag brgyud de srog rtsar zhugs pas dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par dran pa myos shing 'thibs par bsam: de nas las phur bskyed bstim ni: bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang g.yon nyi ma'i gdan la rigs lnga yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba las byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs pa las sras kyi rnam par byung ba ye shes kyi khro bo kī la ya ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pa: dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs shing sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur bu zur gsum pa chu srin gyi kha nas sbrul gyi chun po skyug pa: mgar gyi sol mal nas thon pa ltar me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro zhing gregs 'gugs bsgral gyi las la 89)mnga' dbang bsgyur ba: de'i rgya mdud gong ma na bde gshegs zhi ba'i pho brang: 'chang zung la khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa: rgya mdud 'og ma la dpal gyi bka' srung gi pho brang dang bcas pa rdzogs par gyur: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas sku gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i ye shes yon tan mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang byin dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byung nas phur pa la thim pas dbang byin dngos grub ye shes yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur:

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: oṃ badz+ra sogs: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ badz+ra sogs: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sogs: sarba a bhiṣiñtsa s+t+waṃ: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes brjod pas dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs shing mthu dang nus pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpal chen por dbang bsgyur zhing sku 'gying ba tsam gyis srid pa g.yo nus shing: gsung bsgrags pa tsam gyis gzugs can gzugs med kyi dgra bgegs dam sri thams cad dbang 90)du byed cing dpa' zil bcom pa: thugs g.yo ba tsam gyis srid gsum skad cig la sgrol nus pa'i mthu stobs dpal yon thams cad rdzogs par bsam: de nas tshe lung ni: ngo bo sku gsum ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i klong nas rang byung lhun grub kyi phur pa de nyid dgra bgegs sri ngan rnams kyi gzugs la tshad pa tsam gyis phung khams skye mched thams cad zho ltar dkrugs pas 'o ma las mar thon pa bzhin du dgra bgegs rnams kyi bla'i ngo bo nṛ yig dkar po 'od dang bcas pa zhig chu thig hub kyis drangs pa ltar phur pa'i rtse mor 'dus te phur pa la thim pas phur pa de nyid ngang mer gyis song nas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing rgyal ba rnams kyi phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dbang dang ldan par bsam: slar yang phur pa de nyid dgra bgegs kyi snying gar 'dril ba tsam gyis kho'i tshe bsod nams kyi ngo bo nṛ yig ljang gu'i rnam pa zhig tu gyur pa phur pa'i rtse mo nas 'ub kyis 'dus te khong seng nas dri ma nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs shing dag par byas: phur rtse nas brgyud de rang nyid la thim pas tshe bsod dbang thang thams cad rab tu rgyas par bsam mo: de nas khrus lung ni: slar yang phur 91)pa'i rtse mo nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas dgra bgegs rnams la phog pa tsam gyis kho'i rgyud kyi las dang nyon mongs sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa ltar sangs kyis dag nas me long dri ma med pa bzhin du gyur par bsam moḥ

sarba pā paṃ shud+dhe ye swā hāḥ de nas gnas lung ni: yang phur pa de nyid dgra bgegs sri ngan rnams kyi snying gar btab pas rnam par shes pa sbubs chu 'dren pa bzhin du 'od kyi thig le dkar po gsal la dwangs pa a yig gis mtshan pa can zhig tu gyur pa phur pa'i khong seng nas yar drangs pa'i tshe na kho'i rgyud kyi nyon shes kyi sgrib pa bag chags thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam: phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ ces brjod pa'i dang pos rgya mdud 'og ma nas sprul sku'i dgongs par 'phos par bsam: gnyis pas chang zung nas longs sku'i dgongs par 'dres par bsam: gsum pas rgya mdud gong ma nas chos sku'i dgongs pa'i don rnyed nas slar yang skar mda' chad pa bzhin du mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs kar thim pas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i klong du sangs rgyas par bsam mo: āḥ.āḥphaṭaḥ ces brjod sku gsum mnyam sbyor dbyings: mi dmigs khyab brdal ngang du bzhag: de ltar gnad dang ldan pa na: mthu stobs nus 92) pa'i dpal thob nas: 'khrul pa snang zhen 'phyan pa yi: log 'dren tshogs rnams rdul brlag nas: 'khrul snang rmi lam bzhin du sad: ka dag dbyings su sgrol bar nges: de yis 'khor ba'i sa bon stong: de nas gdab las bya ba ni: dang po phur thun thogs la: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: las byed sprul pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'phros: phur zor drag po dgra bgegs snying la thob: ma rig nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor dbyings su shigs: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du mā ra ya phob dza phob dzaḥ de nas yungs thun ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= las byed= yungs thun drag po char ltar nyi li li: gnod byed dgra bgegs gzugs phung steng du thob: 'khrul snang zhen pa'i 'ching rgya dbyings su khrol: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang sogs: de nas khrag thun ni:

hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= las byed= dmar chen khrag thun drag po sha ra ra: gnod byed dgra bgegs tshor phung steng du thob: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa bdag med chen por sgrol: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang sogs: de nas mtshe thun ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= 93)las byed= mtshe thun drag po skar ltar hri li li: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'du phung rdul du rlogs: 'khor ba'i bag chags skye med dbyings su shig: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang

sogs: de nas dug thun ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= las byed= dug thun drag po dgra dang bgegs la thob: nyon mongs 'khrul snang thal ba rdul du rlogs: zhen med rang grol chos sku'i klong du sgrol: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang sogs: de nas mtshon thun ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= las byed= mtshon thun drag po dgra dang bgegs la phobs: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo dbyings su shigs: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang sogs: de nas mda' thun ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= las byed= mda' thun drag po dgra dang bgegs la phobs: ma rig gzung 'dzin 'ching ba dbyings su shigs: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang sogs: de nas rdo thun ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= las byed= rdo thun drag po thog ltar chi li li: gnod byed dgra bgegs nyon mongs rdul du rlog: 94)'khrul med ye shes chen po'i ngang du shigs: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang sogs: de nas gtor thun ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: nga ni dpal chen= las byed= gtor zor thun gyis dgra bgegs phye mar brlag: srid pa'i rtsa ba dag med chen por sgrol: gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i 'ching rgya dbyings su bcad: spu gri'i sngags mthar: sdang byed dgra dang sogs: de ltar nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgyu: dgra bgegs rnams kyi gzugs phung ste: rgyal gyi phrin las sprul pa ni: thun dang mtshon cha'i rnam par gdab: de yis 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad nas: nyon mongs brgyad khri'i 'khrul 'khor rnams: ye shes chen po'i klong nyid du: skad cig nyid du bsgral ba yis: 'khrul med bde ba'i sa thob bsam: de nas gtun du brdung ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: khro rgyal dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha: ma g.yel dam tshig thugs dam chen pos dgongs: nyams pa bdun ldan dgra bgegs gzugs phung rnams: shes rab sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i mkha' dbyings su:

thabs mchog rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun bus brdung: dgra bgegs gnod byed rdul phran phye mar rlogs: rtsa sngags mthar: dgra bgegs sri ngan thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: ta tha ya ta tha ya rbad rbad sod sod: 95) ces brjod stong dbyings shes rab mo: rol byed nag mo'i mkha' klong du: dgra bgegs gnyis 'dzin phung khams bsdus: thabs mchog khro bo 'thag byed kyi: ye shes rdo rje 'bar bas brdung: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ye shes kyis: zag med bde chen bdud rtsir brlabs: lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas su dmigs: de nas zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag phung khams rus: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol par 'bul: gnyis med bde ba chen po'i dbyings su rolaḥ brdal khyab yangs pa'i klong chen lto bar brubs: mnyes tshim tshogs rdzogs srid mtshor sgrol ba dang: ka dag 'khrul mi shes pa'i sa ru drongs: rtsa sngags: gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi ma hā maṃ sa la khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ṣa la khā hiḥ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hiḥ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hiḥ ma hā ba su ta la khā hiḥ sarba mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes brjod sha khrag bdud rtsi yis: lha tshogs dgyes pa rab bskang nas: tshogs gnyis 'jug pa mthar son te: mi gnas ye shes chen po'i lam: mngon gyur gtan srid zin par bsam: de ltar dmigs pa'i gnad ldan 96) pa: 'tshengs ba bzhi yi dgongs pa'o: sa ma ya: de ltar yi dam drag sgrub zab mo 'di: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skyes bu'i cha rkyen du: mtsho rgyal bdag gis ma hā gu rur zhus: don zab mthu che gnad rnams 'di ru bkrol: chos sgrub rnams kyi bar chad sel phyir dang: bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun brtan phyir las: gnas min gsum gyi yul du gsang ba gnad: skal ldan chos brgyud 'jin pa'i dpal du sprod: rdo rje zhi ba mtsho la bdag gis gdams: da dung ma spel mi 'gyur brda ru thob:

khams kyi 'bri phug mkha' 'gro'i gsang rdzong du: seng gi gnam 'chong 'dra ba'i mgul du sbos: ma 'ongs dus babs nyi shu kha ral tshe: khyod sprul su kha badz+ra gzhon nu ma: khyim pa'i tshul 'dzin lha ldan nub nas 'byung: smon lam dbang gis zab gter 'di 'phrad nas: bdud sprul sap+ta'i rkyen gyis ma bsgyur na: yul gsum bstan pa'i srog shing de yis 'dzin: chos bdag skyes bu mchog lnga yan lag bcu: phran ni nyer lnga g.yang dkar mjug nas ni: ngur mo'i gdong gi bar du rim gyis 'byung: rang rang las 'phro sad pas chos la spyod: ma 'bad don gnyis tshe 'dir 'byung bar nges: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can gyi 97) dbang po bsnubs: dam nyams bstan dgra gdug pa'i srog la ya: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer gyis shig: snod min dam nyams lag tu shor ra re: khams gsum srog gi bdag pos thub par srungs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang skyabs rje 'khor lo'i mgon po gter chen pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi dngos slob dam pa bya bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor kar don nas dngos dang brgyud nas yang yang bskul ba dang*/ nye char dge btsun dam pa yi ge'i ris byed tshul khrims rdo rje dang*/ chos dbyings sgron ma sogs kyis bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// 98)
